admission.justification: Walked-tree merging and workspace page dispatch must not lose delivered members or bind a continuation cursor to the wrong subject. The exact partial/store assertion ranges are retained as bounded non-typed case evidence, not as a supported named-symbol proof or fresh runtime certification.

applicability: Retained walked family context and explicit main-page roster continuation within one mounted reviewer comparison.
conditions: Same-revision family-side reads merge returned members and keep the furthest published cursor.

The main-page continuation control requests the cursor published for its current selected subject; the handler can select a kept family with its retained cursor, but the compact sidebar renders no kept-family continuation control.
Forward and backward traversal select the next or previous drawn changed block in display order or return end; neither selection nor traversal automatically reads a roster page.
exclusions: No j-stop, control-focus, polite-family-stop or next-j promise for a partial kept family in the sidebar.
A retained incomplete roster is not a complete index outline and does not certify absent member content.
Backward traversal does not page a roster.
statement: Within one walked family-side revision, folding roster reads retains every returned member and the furthest page position. Roster continuation is an explicit subject-bound page request; change-traversal keys never request a roster page.
